title: LEGITIMO
style: Dark Memphis phonk at 140 BPM with distorted 808 bass slides, chopped cowbell rhythm, punchy kick, lo-fi vinyl crackle, murky dark pads, and a raw underground mix. Saturated mids, clipped drums, minimal no-pop structure, plus orquesta beat brass hits, trombone stabs, string accents, tiled-bathroom reverb, long opera de adorno en algunas partes, slapback, gritty mono cohesion. Very sparse vocals, flauta and violin motifs.
